findings.title: Version bumped to stable v1.0.0 while closeout report says CI/package verification incomplete
findings.message: The code and metadata declare stable `v1.0.0` (vellum.Version, release/version.json, README), yet the release report states closeout is in progress, CI is unconfirmed, and no final package pass is claimed. Stable identity and API-compatibility promises are being adopted before the release gates are verified.
findings.suggestion: Keep the version as a release candidate until final CI and package verification complete, or land the version bump in the packaging checkpoint after results are recorded.
findings.evidence: Baseline `b633872`; current closeout is in progress. The text-backend cold-compile CI failure is repaired locally with unchanged execution assertions/deadlines. Final workflow success and exact private v1 package results will be recorded after observation; no final CI/package pass is claimed here.
